content.description:
Are You Ready?

CAI is a professional services company established in 1996 that has grown year over year to nearly 750 people worldwide. For Life Sciences and Mission Critical industries that need to deliver critical solutions in high-stakes environments, we provide accelerated operational readiness and unparalleled performance at the highest standard through our rigorous approach, field-tested processes, and elite expertise developed over 30 years.
Our approach is simple because our purpose informs everything we do:

We exist to be the trusted solution for our clients as they strive to build a better working world and improve human experience.

At CAI, we are committed to living our Foundational Principles, both professionally and personally:

We act with integrity
We serve each other
We serve society
We work for our future

At CAI, we believe in a relentless dedication to excellence, pushing boundaries, and surpassing expectations. From the beginning, we’ve challenged ourselves to do what others wouldn’t. Not just setting industry standards but redefining them entirely. We are bold in our thinking and creative in our approach. We operate at the intersection of wisdom and technology and thrive when they come together with humanity. For us, operational readiness isn’t simply a goal. It’s a way of life. Because tomorrow demands to be at the forefront of today. We do this through tireless effort, precision, efficiency, and an unwavering belief that there is always room for advancement. We’re not interested in how it used to be done. We’re obsessed with how it will be done.

We are seeking an experienced Contract Recruiter to join our Talent Acquisition Team and support our Life Sciences Hiring in North America. In this role, you will focus on sourcing, attracting, and hiring top talent for engineering roles within the biopharmaceutical manufacturing space including validation engineers, process engineers, and quality professionals.

Key Responsibilities:
- Partner with hiring managers to understand technical requirements, team dynamics, and role expectations for life sciences manufacturing positions (e.g., validation engineers, CQV engineers, CSV engineers, etc.).
- Develop and execute innovative sourcing strategies to build diverse pipelines of qualified candidates through networking, research, referrals, and direct outreach.
- Manage the full cycle recruiting process, including screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and candidate onboarding support.
- Deliver an exceptional candidate experience by ensuring clear communication, timely feedback, and transparency throughout the process.
- Partner with Human Resources and hiring teams to ensure compliance with company policies and employment regulations.

Qualifications:
- 3–5 years of experience as a recruiter, with at least 2 years focused on biotech, biopharma, pharmaceutical, or medical device manufacturing.
- Proven ability to identify and attract top technical and operations talent in competitive markets.
- Strong knowledge of recruiting tools, ATS systems, and sourcing platforms (e.g., LinkedIn Recruiter, Lever, Indeed, etc.)
- Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
- Ability to manage multiple requisitions and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and follow-through.
